map.ROI 通常指（收入-成本）/成本，含全部投入；ROAS（广告支出回报）是收入/: ROI usually means (revenue - cost) / cost, covering all inputs, while ROAS (return on ad spend) is revenue / ad spend, looking only at the media side. Campaign evaluation is best done with both: ROAS measures acquisition efficiency, ROI measures overall profit and loss.
